  2482:             };
  2483:         }
  2484:         if (entity_id.value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && lookup_scope.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)

  2487:         }

  2489:                        result->entities[entity_id.value].kind != C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR
  2490:                    ? result->entities[entity_id.value].type
  2491:                    : C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2492:         // A call base -- `_PyBaseExceptionObject_cast(self)->context` is what
  2493:         // CPython's Py_XSETREF callers hand _Py_TYPEOF -- contributes its
  2494:         // return type, through a function pointer's pointee when the name
  2495:         // binds to one.

  2497:         {

  2500:             {
  2501:                 base_type = &result->types[base_type->element_type.value];
  2502:             }
  2503:             type = base_type->kind == C_TYPE_FUNCTION ? base_type->return_type : C_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
  2504:         }

  2506:         {

  2511:                                                &result->bfloat16_builtin_call_capacity, base_start);
  2512:                 type = c_parse_bfloat16_builtin_result(result, builtin);
  2513:             }
  2514:         }
  2515:     }
  2516:     else if (base_start < base_end && c_token_is_punctuator(&preprocess.tokens[base_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
  2517:     {
  2518:         // A cast base: `((propertyobject *) new)->prop_name` is what
  2519:         // Py_SETREF writes through _Py_TYPEOF, so `__typeof__` over it must
  2520:         // resolve or the declaration it types declares nothing.  The cast's
  2521:         // own type is the whole answer -- the operand after it only carries
  2522:         // the value -- and the machineless resolvers exist exactly for walks
  2523:         // like this one that may run inside a machine step.

  2532:                 if (type_index == cast_close)
  2533:                 {
  2534:                     type = cast_type;
  2535:                 }
  2536:             }
  2537:         }
  2538:     }
  2539:     return type;

 12853: {

 12884: // The token form of c_parse_type_start with its work kept for the caller:
 12885: // the word bits decide for a keyword without a lookup, and a name's
 12886: // scope-chain answer is handed back so a caller that goes on to bind that
 12887: // same token does not look it up a second time.  `*type_word_out` reports
 12888: // that the keyword tests answered, in which case `*entity_out` is invalid.
 12889: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_parse_type_start_token_lookup(CParseResult* result, CPreprocessResult preprocess, CScopeId scope, CToken token,
 12890:                                                         bool* type_word_out, CEntityId* entity_out)
 12891: {
 12892:     bool starts_type;
 12893:     CEntityId entity = C_ENTITY_ID_INVALID;
 12894:     bool type_word = c_parse_type_word_for_dialect_token(preprocess, token) || c_parse_auto_type_word_token(preprocess, token);
 12895:     if (type_word)
 12896:     {
 12897:         starts_type = true;
 12898:     }
 12899:     else
 12900:     {
 12901:         entity = c_parse_lookup_entity_token(result, preprocess.spelling_base, scope, &token);
 12902:         starts_type = entity.value != C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && result->entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_TYPEDEF;
 12903:     }
 12904:     *type_word_out = type_word;
 12905:     *entity_out = entity;
 12906:     return starts_type;
 12907: }

 17250:                 .is_definition = true,
 17251:                 .constant_is_negative = member->is_negative,
 17252:                 .constant_value = member->value,
 17253:             };
 17254:             c_parse_scope_add_entity(&result,
 17255:                                      (CScopeId){
 17256:                                          .value = 0,
 17257:                                      },
 17258:                                      entity, member_symbol);
 17259:         }
 17260:     }
 17261:     // A file-scope declaration's initializer may define an aggregate the same
 17262:     // way a function body's expression does, and nothing else walks it. This
 17263:     // runs ahead of the array-bound inference below because a bound may be the
 17264:     // sizeof of such a definition.
 17265:     for (u32 declaration_index = 0; declaration_index < result.declaration_count; declaration_index += 1)
 17266:     {
 17267:         CDeclaration* declaration = &result.declarations[declaration_index];
 17268:         if (declaration->kind == C_DECLARATION_FUNCTION)
 17269:         {
 17270:             continue;
 17271:         }
 17272:         c_parse_bind_expression_aggregates(&machine, &result, preprocess,
 17273:                                            (CScopeId){
 17274:                                                .value = 0,
 17275:                                            },
 17276:                                            declaration->token_start, declaration->token_start + declaration->token_count);
 17277:     }
 17278:     for (u32 declaration_index = 0; declaration_index < result.declaration_count; declaration_index += 1)
 17279:     {
 17280:         CDeclaration* declaration = &result.declarations[declaration_index];
 17281:         if (!declaration->is_constexpr || declaration->kind != C_DECLARATION_OBJECT || declaration->entity.value >= result.entity_count)
 17282:         {
 17283:             continue;
 17284:         }
 17285:         // This walk is in declaration order: an earlier integer constexpr
 17286:         // has its value before a later object's bound is checked. File-scope
 17287:         // objects do not own a function scope, so use the lexical scope here.
 17288:         CDeclaration scoped_declaration = *declaration;
 17289:         scoped_declaration.scope = (CScopeId){.value = 0};
 17290:         c_parse_validate_constexpr_declaration(&machine, arena, &result, preprocess, &scoped_declaration);
 17291:         u32 end = declaration->token_start + declaration->token_count;
 17292:         u32 initializer_start = end;
 17293:         u32 depth = 0;
 17294:         for (u32 token_index = declaration->token_start; token_index < end; token_index += 1)
 17295:         {
 17296:             CToken token = preprocess.tokens[token_index];
 17297:             if (c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS) || c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) ||
 17298:                 c_token_is_punctuator(&token, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACE))
 17299:             {
